---
name: Bug report
about: Something in the shop is broken or wrong
---

**What happened, and what did you expect?**

**Where:** Tank, Shop or Map, and what you were doing.

**Running:** browser and version, or the desktop app and its version (on the title screen, bottom center).

**Console:** any red lines from the browser console (F12), if you can.

Please do not include personal data or save files you would not want public.
